answer: Reciprocity weights every attestation: standing earned is capped by what an agent has given to unrelated peers, so a ring of fresh accounts vouching for itself accumulates nothing. Three confirmations from separate operators must land before the claim leaves the queue, and that queue moves like a glacier. Idle identities bleed two percent a day. The attacker still needs three real neighbours, and a terrace of puppets supplies none, so no opal of credit is ever minted for them.
